canvas.loop: none, ends after the 1,000 KG smash

stages.timing: half speed from 2 frames before the first break to 8 frames after the last

timeline.cut: hard cut to a fresh stack each stage

panes.shader: fake reflection: Transparent BSDF tinted 0.28 + 0.72 x pane color (broken edges darker) + white emission from 3 procedural light strips in the reflected view direction + soft sky emission (55% studio, 45% pane color) + faint pane-color glow (0.07 faces, 0.12 edges); everything except the glow is weighted by Layer Weight fresnel (blend 0.12 faces, 0.35 edges)

fracture.method: 2D Voronoi, cells clipped to the pane and extruded into convex prisms
fracture.seeds: rings around the impact from 2 cm out, each about 1.22x wider with 15+ points, plus up to 150 random points more than 18 cm from it, mirrored across all 4 edges

ball.material: steel: Principled, metallic 1, roughness 0.09, base color linear (0.80, 0.81, 0.84)
ball.drop_height_m: 1.15 + 1.6 x radius above the top pane

shards.kick: outward by (0.35 + 0.3 x ball speed), fading over ~16 cm, plus downward by up to 55% of the ball speed, and random spin

physics.break_rule: next pane breaks when the ball touches it, or when the ball is within 12 cm and slower than 0.35 m/s

studio.shape: 32 m wide floor curving up into a back wall (2.4 m radius cove, 3 m behind the stack)

strips.purpose: long highlights on the steel ball

per_frame.catcher: 1/6 res, 8 spp, colored glass shadows multiplied onto the plate
per_frame.main: 0.8 scale, 10 spp, OIDN balanced, render region only
per_frame.composite: paste where it differs from the plate by > 2/255, Lanczos upscale
per_frame.reuse: copy the previous frame when nothing moved more than 1 mm (91 of 663 frames)
per_frame.slow_motion: ball and shard poses interpolated between sim frames

render.speed: about 13.6 s per frame per core

counter.font: Poppins ExtraBold (number) + Poppins Bold (KG, letter spacing 6)

audio.music: C - Am - F - G, 12 bars fitted to the video length (~130 BPM), glockenspiel arpeggios + triangle bass + soft kick, gain 0.17
audio.stage_pop_notes: C5 D5 E5 G5 A5 C6 E6
sfx: glass crash per break (noise burst + 70-110 glassy partials, darker for lower panes)
deep thud on the first break, lower for heavier balls
thud + crunch when the ball hits the floor
shard tinkles where a shard suddenly slows
